answer: One concrete mechanism: pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because ferrous only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. Concretely, cedar is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any glacier approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
